core_philosophy.primary_objective: Preserve capital, provide stable income, and protect purchasing power during uncertain economic and geopolitical environments.
core_philosophy.secondary_objective: Maintain psychological durability — 'Sleep Well at Night' portfolio.
operating_principles: SGOV used as staging and liquidity vehicle
Short-duration, high-quality bonds preferred over credit risk
Gold used as structural diversifier, not speculation
Rebalancing only when materially off target
core_philosophy.philosophy_summary: Portfolio designed for resilience, not maximum return.

phase_4: GLDM allocation completed fully (no tactical timing)
Deployment completed with discipline despite geopolitical stress

funding_rule: Sell required dollar amount from SGOV only
Do not sell bonds, equities, or gold for RMD
No rebalancing triggered by RMD event
rmd_policy.liquidity_strategy: Maintain 2–3 years of RMD coverage implicitly inside SGOV

gold_policy.discipline: Do not trim based on recent performance alone

deployment_rules_future_capital: Deploy gradually using proportional shortfall method
No new funds added without deliberate redesign

rebalance_if: Any major sleeve deviates >5% from target

behavioral_commitment.principle: The edge is discipline, not prediction.

next_major_action.next_review: End of quarter or annually unless structural deviation occurs
